title: Asset Exposure Management (AEM): the asset inventory, coverage gaps and policies, and what can be automated

prose.label: Where its data goes.
prose.text: {{informs-risk360-uvm}} External attack surface findings merge into it through the platform's EASM integration: [[portfolio.secops-platform:easm-and-predr]]; EASM's own API is in [[easm.api]].

prose.label: Pages and policies.
prose.text: Assets: [[aem.assets]]. Policies: [[aem.policies]], with Tool Coverage, CMDB Hygiene and OS End of Life in [[aem.policy-templates]]. Policy violations: [[aem.policy-violations]]. Violation tickets: [[aem.violation-tickets]], with grouping in [[aem.ticket-grouping-rules]] and statuses and workflows in [[aem.ticket-lifecycle]]. Dashboards: [[aem.dashboards]].

prose.label: Data sources and reports.
prose.text: AEM shares the platform's data sources, field mapping and Reporting API: [[portfolio.secops-platform]].

{{no-client-surface}} Report export is the only programmatic path a source shows, through [[portfolio.secops-platform:reporting-api]], and its contract is open: [[portfolio.secops-platform:reporting-api-contract]].

checks.do: For automating AEM, use saved reports and the SecOps Reporting API; no captured source or client exposes AEM configuration or a query API.

what-it-is.statement: AEM collects and manages asset data from various sources to track asset inventory and coverage, so that organizations can understand their attack surface, create policies, and track and remediate policy violations.

quotes: Asset Exposure Management (AEM) enables organizations to collect and manage asset data from various sources to track asset inventory and coverage. It allows organizations to understand their attack surface, create policies, and track and remediate policy violations to reduce overall risk.

golden-record.statement: Zscaler's AEM product page says it gives a high-fidelity "golden record" of all assets, a complete, accurate and context-rich asset inventory, and lists multi-source entity deduplication and golden-record creation by correlating all data.

quotes: Get a high-fidelity “golden record” of all your assets Achieve a complete, accurate, and context-rich asset inventory through a fundamentally different approach to CAASM, empowering you to reduce asset risk like never before.
Multi-Source Entity Deduplication Synthesize assets reported by multiple disparate tools.
Asset "Golden Record" Creation Correlate all data to create a complete asset view.

coverage-and-cmdb.statement: The product page lists coverage gap identification, with misconfigurations such as assets lacking EDR, inactive asset recognition, and CMDB health features: identifying assets not registered in the CMDB, and discovering assets not previously known but seen in network traffic.

quotes: Easily pinpoint potential compliance issues and misconfigurations (e.g., assets lacking EDR, outdated agent versions), and turn them into actionable tasks to enhance your security posture.
Coverage Gap Identification Understand when proper asset security controls are not sufficient.
Inactive Asset Recognition Define criteria to identify inactive or decommissioned assets.
Identify assets not registered in your CMDB or missing owner, location information, or other details.
Missing Asset Discovery Identify assets not previously known but seen in network traffic.

marketing-missing-assets.statement: Zscaler's AEM product page says that on average Zscaler reveals 20-30% of assets missing from inventory.

quotes: 20-30% of assets missing from inventory are revealed by Zscaler, on average

remediation-actions.statement: The product page lists CMDB enrichment with missing assets or elements, triggering built-in or custom access policies for risky assets, automated remediation workflows via ticketing systems, and assigning policy violations to the right owner.

quotes: CMDB Enrichment Automatically update the CMDB with missing assets or elements.
Policy Initiation Trigger built-in or custom access policies for risky assets.
Workflow Creation Initiate automated remediation workflows via ticketing systems.
Task Assignment Assign policy violations to the right owner with actionable information.

informs-risk360-uvm.statement: The product page's use cases pair accurate vulnerability analysis and risk-based prioritization, from comprehensive asset visibility and context, with a link to UVM, and more accurate attack-surface risk quantification, from a complete understanding of all assets, with a link to Risk360.

quotes: Achieve accurate vulnerability analysis and risk-based prioritization with comprehensive asset visibility and context. Learn more about UVM
Quantify risk for your attack surface far more accurately with complete understanding of all the assets in your organization. Learn more about Risk360

no-client-surface.statement: No vendored client covers AEM: the Go and Python SDKs, the Terraform providers, the Ansible collections, the MCP server, the OneAPI Postman collection and the captured Automate contract have no AEM, Asset Exposure Management or CAASM service.

quotes: used in your server-side code to interact with the Zscaler API platform across multiple products such as:

no-client-surface.conditions: Rests on an absence. The Python README's product list (introduced by the quoted line) names no AEM API, and at the pins `git grep -i -E 'asset.exposure|caasm'` finds nothing in the Go or Python SDKs, the ZIA, ZPA, ZCC or ZTC providers, the Ansible collections or the MCP server; the Postman collection has no match. The MCP server's EASM tools and the generated `easm` surface cover External Attack Surface Management, not AEM.
